name: HomeHub
description: HomeHub 🏡 is a thoughtfully designed web application that serves as a digital command center for families and shared households. Its main purpose is to simplify daily coordination and communication by combining essential household tools into one cohesive, easy-to-use platform. Instead of juggling multiple apps or handwritten lists, HomeHub offers an all-in-one environment where everything from chores and groceries to notes and shared expenses can be organized effortlessly.
short_desc: A modern hub for family organization
author: Suraj Verma
